figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the Identity-Decoupled MRAG Framework. The pipeline proceeds in three phases: (1) Multi-modal Retrieval: A user query (𝑞) retrieves relevant raw images (𝐼𝑟𝑎𝑤) from a database.
